entries.distinction: Enjoying tidiness, ordinary checking or having an unwanted thought does not establish OCD. OCPD is a different diagnosis concerning a broader pattern of order, perfectionism and control. A visible ritual alone does not tell you the person’s experience or its cause.
entries.readerQuestion: What experience is distressing or time-consuming, how does it affect life, and what professional support would help?

related.why: Clinical vocabulary is educational; a link is not evidence that a person has a condition.
Assessment and support should address the person’s actual difficulties and wishes.

researchLead.name: US National Institute of Mental Health: OCD
researchLead.note: Public clinical guidance describes recurring obsessions, compulsions or both, associated distress and effects on daily life. OCD is different from obsessive-compulsive personality disorder. An app description does not replace assessment.
